# RACI Matrix — {PROJECT_NAME}

> **Output file location:** `docs/pm/RACI.md`
> **When to fill:** Phase 0 (Q0d — Stakeholder Register), before kick-off meeting.
> **Mandatory for:** Medium+ projects per Cross-phase rule 21 (SKILL.md).
> **Solo projects:** skip this file. Use `docs/pm/STAKEHOLDERS.md` with a one-paragraph
>   "I make all decisions" statement instead.

---

## How to read this matrix

| Letter | Stands for | Meaning |
|--------|-----------|---------|
| **R** | Responsible | Does the work. At least one R per row. |
| **A** | Accountable | Signs off. Exactly one A per row — never more than one. |
| **C** | Consulted | Provides input before or during. Two-way communication. |
| **I** | Informed | Receives updates after. One-way communication. |
| *(blank)* | Not involved | No role in this decision or deliverable. |

**Veto power** (record explicitly when applicable): the A-holder on a row has
final decision authority. If the A-holder has a formal veto right beyond normal
sign-off (e.g. legal can block a release, sponsor can kill a milestone), mark
it as **A★** and document the trigger condition in the Notes column.

## Escalation Ladder

> If a decision owner is unavailable or a conflict cannot be resolved at the
> Responsible level, escalate in this order. Reference CONFLICT_RESOLUTION_GUIDE.md.

1. **Direct negotiation** (0–1 day) — between the conflicting parties
2. **Mediation** (1–2 days) — {PM} as mediator
3. **Authority decision** (2–3 days) — {TL} for technical, {Sponsor} for business, {Client} for scope
4. **Steering committee** (3–5 days) — {Sponsor + Client PIC + PM} — for cross-party conflicts
5. **Legal escalation** (5+ days) — {Legal} — only for contractual disputes

> Document every Level 3+ escalation outcome in `docs/pm/DECISIONS.md`.
